value.notes: First exploratory run. Goals: learn the map from tiles output, check pause freezes timer/moves, check dash recharge (should show Dash 5 right after dash), check that pause+left in same tick does nothing, check HUD matches state. Next: explore map, collect items, test lever/gates, spikes, enemy contact, timer, dialogs and buttons.

Run 2 goal: check pause+right same tick (should not move, game paused), Enter closes pause, dash-down from (1,1) should land (1,3) with Dash 5, then pause/click Resume freezes and resumes. Run 1 looked fine (bumps, dash countdown, coin pickup, pause freeze). Untested: lever/gates, keys/doors, spikes, enemy contact, timer expiry, Finish/Retry/Play again, restart.

Run 3: check whether HUD Time desyncs from state.timeLeft after pause -> click Resume. Prior run 2 showed state time 296/295 while HUD Time stuck at 297. Suspected stale HUD timer. If confirmed, minimise and report. Untested still: lever/gates, keys/doors, spikes, enemy contact, timer expiry, Finish/Retry/Play again, restart. Budget is very tight (~$0.25), so prioritise confirming this bug and finishing.

reports.title: HUD Time stays stale after resuming via Resume button
reports.observed: After pause then click:btn-resume, the state timeLeft drops (e.g. 297->296->295) but the HUD Time field still shows 297.
reports.expected: HUD Time always shows the current timer value (state.timeLeft).

value.notes: Run 4 checks whether the HUD Time desync needs the pause/resume path. Run 3 (pause, click:btn-resume, wait, wait) showed state time 297 while HUD Time read 300, so the HUD looks stale. If plain waits keep the HUD in step with state, the pause/Resume path is the trigger. Next: confirm, minimise, and finish.

value.notes: Run 5: replaying run 3 to confirm the HUD Time vs state mismatch after pause/Resume. Run 4 (plain waits) kept HUD and state in step (both 297), so the pause/Resume path looks like the trigger. If the replay confirms the mismatch, minimise further and finish. Current reports: one state_desync (HUD Time stale after Resume).

value.notes: Run 5 replayed run 3 and confirmed the mismatch. After pause, click:btn-resume, and two waits, the state shows timeLeft 299, 298, 297 but the HUD Time field stays at 300 on every tick. Plain waits (run 4) keep HUD and state in step (297), so the pause/Resume path is the trigger. The minimal 4-token reproduction is [pause, click:btn-resume, wait, wait]. I'm finishing here because the remaining budget is small and this is the only bug confirmed so far.
